actions.create_finetune.description: Adds a new fine-tune (question + suggested answer) for the specified chatbot in SiteSpeakAI.
actions.create_finetune.props.question.d: The question text you want the chatbot to be able to answer.
actions.create_finetune.props.suggestedA: The answer you suggest the chatbot use for that question.
actions.delete_finetune.description: Deletes a fine-tune entry from the selected chatbot.
actions.delete_finetune.props.finetuneId: Select the finetune entry to delete.
actions.sendQuery.description: Sends a query to the specified chatbot and retrieves a response.
actions.sendQuery.props.conversationId.d: Pick a conversation for context, or leave empty to start a new one.
actions.sendQuery.props.format.descripti: Format of the returned response; markdown or html.
actions.sendQuery.props.prompt.descripti: The question or query text you want the chatbot to answer.
auth.description:
**Enter your SiteSpeakAI API Key.**
---
### How to obtain your API key
1. Sign up / log in at [SiteSpeakAI](https://sitespeak.ai/).
2. Go to **Dashboard → Settings → API Keys**.
3. Generate or copy an API key.
4. Paste it here.
